modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organise work as per organisation’s current health, safety and security policies and procedures
report any identified breaches in health, safety, and security policies and procedures to the designated person
identify the risks and hazards associated with work activities, their causes and prevention

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure work area is clean and tidy
ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
sanitize workstation and equipment regularly
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation

report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority

carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

modules.module_title: Prepare to carry out routine service and minor repairs

pcs.pc_description: identify the auto component manufacturer specifications related to the various components/aggregates in the vehicle
review the job card and understand work to be carried out
conduct test drive to assess calibration, other adjustments and repairs if any, in the electrical/mechanical aggregates of the vehicle
inspect the machining/repair done by outside source/local machining garages
use checklist for confirming routine servicing tasks and coordinate with superior for non-routine service or repair, if any

modules.module_title: Perform routine service and minor repairs of mechanical & electrical aggregates

pcs.pc_description: use workshop tools and equipment for service and minor aggregate repairs, as per standard operating procedures
perform routine service/maintenance of various parts and aggregates including engine, sub- assemblies and systems, drive line, chasis, suspension, brake, electrical components etc.
collect the correct spare parts and appropriate grade of lubricants, coolant, oils and grease for routine maintenance and service
inspect the components requiring replacement due to continuous wear and tear such as filters, belts, wiper blades, brake linings and pads
clean and condition dismantled components, including mechanical and electrical aggregates, prior to assembly
dispose off materials such as waste oil, scrap of failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components while working on other aggregates
complete the tasks assigned before releasing vehicle for the next procedure and record all repairs carried out
carry out scheduled checks, calibration and timely repairs for workshop tools, equipment and workstations
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment, and report if any malfunctions are observed to the person concerned
check the performance of vehicle/aggregate post repair and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by other specialist
